_comment: chartevents/inputevents/outputevents store a numeric itemid, not a named column — 'heart rate' only exists as itemid 220045 inside chartevents rows, and d_items often has several similarly-named itemids (e.g. the actual Heart Rate reading vs. its high/low alarm thresholds, which are separate rows and NOT the measurement). This file pins the verified-correct itemid(s) for each clinically relevant concept so the agent doesn't have to guess or accidentally pick an alarm/score/text itemid at query time. Same purpose as clinical_terms.json but for icu/ event tables instead of ICD codes. Row counts below are against the current 1500-patient cohort (2026-09) — re-verify if the cohort changes materially.

blood_pressure_systolic_arterial._note: invasive arterial line reading, more accurate but only present when a line is placed

blood_pressure_mean_arterial._note: MAP — used directly in SOFA cardiovascular scoring

temperature_fahrenheit._note: some rows are charted in F and some in C — check both unless you convert

spo2._note: pulse oximetry; excludes 223769/223770 which are alarm limits, not readings

arterial_o2_saturation._note: from ABG — more accurate than SpO2 but charted far less frequently

gcs_eye_opening._note: d_items marks this param_type='Text' but valuenum is populated with the numeric score — verified

gcs_motor_response._note: total GCS = eye + verbal + motor, max 15

epinephrine._note: excludes itemid 229617 ('Epinephrine.') — near-duplicate label, verify before using

phenylephrine._note: excludes concentration-variant itemids 229630/229631/229632 and the intubation-specific 229789

normal_saline._note: 0.9% NaCl — main crystalloid for sepsis fluid resuscitation

urine_output._note: Foley catheter output — the primary urine output measurement; used in SOFA renal scoring and AKI monitoring
